title: Labels v0: hand-worked truth for one site
description: What a person worked out for a site, independent of any criteria path. Truth values follow PR #4: pass and fail are outside the labeller's own uncertainty; borderline means the truth itself sits within its uncertainty of a threshold (a correct path says unsure); unknown means the labeller could not settle it (not scored).

site_decision.description: The placement decision a correct path must reach for the whole site.

criterion.description: Criterion id, or 'placement' for a start range's overall outcome (worst of all placement checks).

start_s_m.description: Battery left-edge positions this label covers (scene s, meters).

truth.description: not_pass: the labeller can say it must not pass (fail or unsure both acceptable), as in PR #13's outcome_not.
